item.title: Safely Roll Out Changes in .NET with AWS AppConfig Feature Flags
item.description: Introduction With AWS AppConfig, a capability of AWS Systems Manager, you can use feature flags to roll out changes in your .NET application incrementally, giving you fine-grained control over releasing new features. You deploy new code while keeping them inactive until you explicitly enable them at runtime.
